name: v0.3.27 — engagement-tile widths align with PaymentTile row + +g alias on Connections
releaseNotes:
• Dashboard engagement tiles (GuacScore · GuacWizard · GuacMoney · Rewards) bumped 180px → 220px so they match the PaymentTile row below them. Top row no longer looks narrower than the bottom.
• Connections page now shows the correct `+g` subaddress (rdasaradi+g@getguac.app) — that's the auto-parsing endpoint per /how-email-works. The bare @getguac.app address is for personal mail and stays untouched. Retailers go to +g.
